Context: 1. Applicable to a dependent family member of.-

Service includes extension in service (but not re-employment). Service includes re-employment of Ex-Servicemen in civil post before the normal  
age of retirement.  
Dependent family member means (a) spouse; (b) son I daughter (including adopted son I adopted daughter) and (c) brother or sister in the case of unmarried Government servant/ member of the Armed Forces at the time of his death in harness/ retirement on medical grounds, as the case may be.
